Plot treatment means with their letters

Source: R/graphics.R
plot.ad_comparison.Rd

Draws the means of a comparison from compare_means() as bars or points with error bars, or the observations as box plots or points, and writes the letters of the groups above them. With simple effects (by), the means are grouped by the levels of the other factor and the letters are valid within each group.

Usage

# S3 method for class 'ad_comparison'
plot(
  x,
  style = c("bars", "points", "box", "strip"),
  error = c("se", "ci", "none"),
  letters = TRUE,
  values = FALSE,
  sort = FALSE,
  col = NULL,
  main = NULL,
  xlab = NULL,
  ylab = NULL,
  ylim = NULL,
  letter_cex = 1.1,
  digits = 2,
  ...
)

Arguments

x

An "ad_comparison" object.

style

"bars", "points", "box" (box plots of the observations) or "strip" (every observation, with the mean and its error bar).

error

Error bars: "se" (standard error of the mean), "ci" (95 % confidence interval with the error degrees of freedom) or "none".

letters

Write the letters of the groups.

values

Write the value of each mean.

sort

Sort the levels by their mean, highest first.

col

Fill colours, one per level (default: agri_colors()).

main, xlab, ylab

Titles; NULL builds them from the analysis.

ylim

Range of the vertical axis.

letter_cex

Size of the letters.

digits

Decimals of the values written with values = TRUE.

...

Further graphical parameters passed to graphics::plot.window().

Value

Invisibly, a data frame with the position, mean, error-bar limits and letters of every level.

Examples

fit <- design_anova(maize_nitrogen, "Yield_t_ha", "Nitrogen_kg_ha", block = "Block")
cmp <- compare_means(fit, "Nitrogen_kg_ha")
plot(cmp)

plot(cmp, style = "box")


fit <- design_anova(split_irrigation, "Yield_t_ha", c("Irrigation", "Variety"),
                    block = "Block", design = "split_rcbd")
plot(compare_means(fit, "Variety", by = "Irrigation"))
